episodeTitle: Vennila Struggles to Retrieve The House Documents
description: Vennila scolds Vaanmathi for mortgaging the house and struggles to retrieve the document.
Shunned by her family over false accusations against her mother, Ayali tolerates her stepmom’s cruelty and teams up with Siva to expose Varma and prove her mother's innocence.

episodeTitle: Divakaran Learns The Truth About Jayanthi
description: Jayanthi tries to fake pregnancy in front of Divakaran but learns the truth.
